text:
Maria G: Quick dry-run for profiling tomorrow morning (~9:30 PT). Need to capture a short nsys + torch.prof pair to compare batch=1 vs batch=8 latency and KV-cache behavior. Anyone available to run it on the RTX box? We'll keep traces <3min and scrub any prompt text before upload.

Anil R: I can take this. Do we want kernel symbols? I only have ~40GB free on that node.

Maria G: Minimal symbols are fine (no full kernel debug). Plan is to collect a tiny nsys + torch.prof pair with these flags:

```
nsys profile --sample=none -t cuda,cuda_driver --output=/tmp/prof.nsys --duration=180 \
  --trace-fork-before-exec true --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi python run_bench.py --batch 1
```

and the torch.prof snippet for the short window (forward only):

```
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.CUDA],
    schedule=torch.profiler.schedule(wait=0, warmup=1, active=3)) as p:
    model(batch)
    p.step()
```

Keep env:
`export PYTORCH_PROFILER_ENABLE=1; export PERF_STAGING=staging/perf/tmp-2799990000`

Anil R: OK. How do we want artifacts named and where to stage them? I can upload to `s3://staging/perf/tmp-2799990000/`. Do we need explicit consent from privacy for logs?

Jamie T: Please redact any prompt text before upload. perf-bot has a quick consent checklist — run `perf-bot consent check` in thread. Also include the exact command, seed, and model hash in the README.

perf-bot: consent required: PII_scrub (yes), kernel_symbols (no), internal_config (yes). Recommended retention: 7d. Use `perf-bot /consent mark done` after upload.

Maria G: Thanks. @Anil R please run batch=1 then batch=8, attach `prof.nsys` and `torchprof.json` plus a README with commands and seed. I'll run a small flamegraph conversion and post a short diff. Ping the thread when uploads are done :thumbsup:

Anil R: On it — I'll run at ~9:20 PT and upload to s3. Will redact prompts and follow the README template. cc @Jamie T for anything I miss.

Jamie T: optional: set `export TORCH_CPP_LOG_LEVEL=info` to help catch kernel fallbacks. Also note GPU util tends to spike on batch8 — try a warmup of 3 iters before capture.

Anil R: noted, will include warmup and that env var. Posting back when upload completes.
